text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 3) 2022.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 27 Mei 2022.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 27 Mei 2022 hingga 4 Jun 2022.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kerbau import (India) (tidak termasuk bahagian batang pinang)

2. Kepak ayam

3. Babi hidup

4. Daging babi (perut)

5. Daging babi (daging dan lemak)

Dibuat 18 Mei 2022

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 3) ORDER 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 3) Order 2022.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 27 May 2022.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for the

period from 27 May 2022 to 4 June 2022.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Imported buffalo meat (India) (not including tenderloin)

2. Chicken wing

3. Live pig

4. Pork (belly)

5. Pork (lean and fat)

Made 18 May 2022

[KPDN (PGK) (S) 0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/Jld. 13]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

Minister of Domestic Trade and Consumer Affairs
